title: Wilbur Dinkle, Fazola and the Dauphine and Palace pits
summary: Fazola played in Wilbur Dinkle's burlesque pit band as a youngster. Weinstein played the Palace vaudeville pit and many jobs with Faz, including the Hollywood.
